company.shortDescription: Blixo is a subscription management, and accounts receivable platform.
company.description: Blixo provides a platform that automatically charges customers using their saved payment information. Set up subscription plans or set recurring invoices to autopay. Send emails, text messages, phone calls, and letters to remind your customers to pay. Customers can download invoices, view and download statements, view and download payment history receipts, manage subscription plans.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,374,869 to $5,374,869, a 1x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
